name: Search Field
description: Native search input for finding existing content. It owns query entry and clearing anatomy while result filtering, counts, empty results, debouncing, selection, and announcements remain pattern or product concerns.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required native accessible name for the search input; the placeholder never substitutes for it.

props.name: clearButtonLabel
props.description: Required accessible name forwarded to the internal clear Icon Button, for example Clear search.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Forwarded native disabled state for the search input and its clear affordance.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Optional component-owned callback invoked when the enabled clear action is activated.

representations.mapsTo: private input-control CSS from native input:hover
private input-control CSS from native input:focus-visible
native disabled plus disabled clear Icon Button when query is filled
internal dse.icon-button presence when current query is non-empty

anatomy.name: input-control
anatomy.description: Private dse._input-control shell using compact 40px size.

anatomy.name: search-icon
anatomy.description: Fixed decorative 20px search icon at inline-start.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Native type=search input that owns query value, focus, disabled state, and change behavior.

anatomy.name: clear-action
anatomy.description: Governed Icon Button at inline-end, present only while the current query is non-empty.

states.name: hover
states.description: Visual hover is derived from the native search input and private shell.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Focus presentation is derived from native search-input focus-visible.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Native disabled input state also disables a visible clear action.

semantics.accessibleName: Required native aria-label owns the search input accessible name independently from placeholder content.
semantics.keyboardActivation: native search text-input behavior plus native button activation for the clear action
semantics.focus: native input focus with visible private-shell focus treatment; focus returns to the search input after clearing
requirements: The Search Field always composes the compact 40 CSS pixel private input-control shell; no public size prop exists.
The native input is always type=search and consumer type overrides are not supported.
The required aria-label names the search input independently from its placeholder.
Controlled value and uncontrolled defaultValue usage are both supported through native input behavior.
The clear action is present only while the current query is non-empty.
clearButtonLabel provides the clear button accessible name and is never replaced by the X glyph.
Activating the clear action clears uncontrolled query state, invokes onClear when supplied, and restores focus to the search input.
For controlled query state, onClear notifies the owner to update value and focus still returns to the search input.
When disabled and filled, the clear affordance remains visible but its Icon Button is disabled.
Logical inline positioning preserves RTL layout; search and X glyphs do not mirror.
The browser-provided search cancel affordance is suppressed so only the governed clear action is exposed.
No aria-invalid or validation/error presentation is accepted by Search Field; no-result status belongs outside the field.

input-control.description: Private governed shell; consumers cannot replace it or import it through the public React package.

clear-action.description: Internal composition of the governed public Icon Button with a fixed X glyph and consumer-supplied accessible name.
